rows.grounds: locative of place indicating the ritual ground
past participle qualifying the altar as consecrated
direct object of the act of placing
absolutive expressing prior action by the teacher

items.question: On what prepared ground may the teacher establish the ritual fire?
premises: A purified altar serves as the ground for ritual action.
The teacher is the agent who places the fire.
Placing the fire follows the preparation of the ground.
items.inference: The teacher should establish the fire on a purified altar.
items.plain_english: Or, having placed the fire on a purified altar, the teacher proceeds.
